name: dungeon-blitz-r-launcher
description: Dungeon Blitz: R launcher (Rust/Tauri, src-tauri/): build tools for the game engines it ships -- Adobe AIR, and Adobe's standalone Flash Player where AIR has no runtime

scripts.build:bridge: cmake -S native_bridge -B native_bridge/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build native_bridge/build --config Release
scripts.test: node tools/test-launcher-status.js && node tools/test-flash-preload.js && node tools/test-air-engine.js

author: The Minesa Studios
